name: Call me back
text: Our phone team is available every day, 7am to 9pm Central Time, including weekends. Pick a time that works for you and we will call you back.

name: Damaged item (Trailhead Plus)
text: As a Trailhead Plus member, you can choose a full refund for a damaged item and keep the item. No need to send it back.

name: Where is my order
text: Orders ship within 2 business days. You will get a tracking link by email as soon as your order leaves our warehouse.
